CITY CLERK
GLOUCESTER, MA
2026 SEP 23 AM 10:02

This meeting is recorded

# GLOUCESTER CITY COUNCIL
## Budget & Finance Committee Meeting
Thursday, October 8, 2026 – 5:30 p.m.
City Hall
1st Floor Council Conference Room
9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930

The public is welcome to attend in person. Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available.
Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/81398727895
Join via Phone: 1 929 205 6099 or 1 301 715 8592
Meeting ID: 813 9872 7895

*Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.*

## AGENDA
### Individual items from committee reports may be consolidated into a consent agenda

1. Memorandum from the Archives Committee requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $185
2. Memorandum from the Cape Ann Veterans Services Director requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $2,785
3. Memorandum from the Director of Elder Services requesting acceptance of donations in the amount of $10,050
4. Memorandum from the Interim Police Chief requesting approval to utilize funds for the Recovery Coach Academy
5. Memorandum from the Interim Police Chief requesting acceptance of the FY27 State 911 Training Grant in the amount of $95,636.25
6. Memorandum from the Interim Police Chief requesting acceptance of the FY27 Support and Incentive Grant in the amount of $102,983
7. Memorandum from the City Clerk & #2027-SBT-1 in the amount of $9,922.24 & #2027-SBT-2 in the amount of $401.33 to reimburse the Police Department for the police details at all polling places for the September 1, 2026 State Primary
8. Memorandum from the City Auditor & #2027-SA-3 in the amount of $12,000 to install a portion of the Wayfinding Signs Project
9. CC#2026-018 (Gross): Amend Ch. 2 "Administration," Art. 2 "City Council," Sec. 28 "Fees" by DELETING "and published in a local newspaper whenever fee changes or new fees are approved by the City Council."
10. Memorandum from the City Auditor regarding accounts having expenditures which exceed their authorization & Auditor's Report and other related business

This meeting is recorded

## MATTERS TO BE CONTINUED

1. Memorandum from the Principal Assessor regarding tax classification (cont. October 22, 2026)

B&F COMMITTEE
Chair, Councilor Scott Memhard
Vice Chair, Councilor Tony Gross
Councilor, Patti-Ann Page

CC: Mayor Paul Lundberg; Kelly Dolan; Grace E. Poirier; Kenny Costa; Nicolette Parisi; Elise Sinagra; Vionette Chipperini; Michael Williams
**The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may be discussed & other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law. Items may be taken out of order.**
summary: The Gloucester City Council Budget & Finance Committee will meet on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. to review requests to accept several donations and grants, approve funds for the Police Department's Recovery Coach Academy and polling place reimbursements, approve $12,000 for the Wayfinding Signs Project, consider an amendment to the City Council fee publication rule (CC#2026-018), and review the City Auditor's report on accounts exceeding their authorized expenditures. The tax classification memorandum from the Principal Assessor is continued to October 22, 2026.
items: Accept donations of $185 for the Archives Committee
Accept donations of $2,785 for Cape Ann Veterans Services
Accept donations of $10,050 for Elder Services
Approve use of funds for the Recovery Coach Academy, requested by the Interim Police Chief
Accept the FY27 State 911 Training Grant in the amount of $95,636.25, requested by the Interim Police Chief
Accept the FY27 Support and Incentive Grant in the amount of $102,983, requested by the Interim Police Chief
Reimburse the Police Department $9,922.24 (#2027-SBT-1) and $401.33 (#2027-SBT-2) for polling place details during the September 1, 2026 State Primary
Approve $12,000 (#2027-SA-3) to install part of the Wayfinding Signs Project
Consider CC#2026-018 (Gross), amending Ch. 2 Sec. 28 to remove the requirement for newspaper publication of fee changes
Review the City Auditor's memorandum on accounts with expenditures exceeding their authorization, and the Auditor's Report
Continue the Principal Assessor's memorandum on tax classification to October 22, 2026
